notes.title: Hotfix - OLT v1.2
notes.content:
I am releasing this hotfix mainly to address a game-crashing bug reported by Shiba (many thanks for reporting this). 

Since I was at it, I cleaned and polished a few more things.

Below is the list of all the changes.


Bug fixes
Added a guard to prevent Pig Bepi from crashing the game when de-spawning under certain conditions

Clean up bomb fields (an intended effect of exploding molotovs) after a few seconds, to prevent them from accumulating indefinitely

Allow molotovs to actually scare Pig Bepi away like other weapons

Fixed collision setup that would allow molotovs to damage enemies behind certain walls

Prevent player from dying if it gets hit after a boss is defeated
Cosmetic changes
Ensure that player weapon is invisible in cutscene that didn't hide it correctly



Thank you for your reports, they help me deliver a better experience for everyone!

notes.title: One Last Toast Is Out!
notes.content:
One Last Toast is Out!
Bepi's Mansion has opened its doors to the public…

Whoever dares to attend the party is in for a short but intense adventure, one that brings back the classic survival horror vibes of the ’90s. Expect zombies, monsters, puzzles, and weird contraptions inside a sprawling mansion where everything went horribly wrong after Bepi's latest wine presentation.

This is my first commercial release, and I sincerely hope it offers you a few hours of classic entertainment.

See you inside. 🕯️
